verified_company_truth: uka describes its head spa as a method developed by refining salon shampoo/hand techniques over time.
The Deep Care Method connects muscle, blood-flow, scalp and hair as a care concept and starts with consultation/observation/touch before the treatment sequence.
Current official material presents multiple head-spa directions, including regenerative, total-care and dry-spa options, selected by concern/purpose.
The Total Care menu currently includes AI diagnosis/counseling followed by a sequenced hands-on care process and is listed for specific salons.
Official salon pages provide online/phone reservation routes and concrete store information.
Sensory relaxation is material, but the first-party story repeatedly makes technique, practitioner judgment and accumulated method part of the service value.

customer_decision_state.before: The customer understands head spa as a category but must decide whether uka's practitioner-led method and care philosophy are credible and relevant to their concern.
customer_decision_state.first_persuasive_job: make human technique, accumulated method and practitioner judgment indispensable to trust before asking the customer to book
customer_decision_state.after: The customer understands what the method is, how consultation relates to the sequence, which care direction may fit, and can choose a salon/menu booking route.
customer_decision_state.decision_job_signal: human craft/provenance leads; process proof and sensory experience support

creative_fit.score_semantics: Issue #49 expert ordinal strength; not probability or learned runtime weight

collision_surfaces.resolution: Human technique/provenance is the meaning carrier; method/process proof supports it rather than becoming the sole efficacy story.
Sensory relaxation is strong, but atmosphere is not sufficient to explain why uka should be chosen; practitioner technique and accumulated method are indispensable.

family_inference_trace.human_review_trigger: If inference becomes process-only (F06) or atmosphere-only (F01), inspect whether human technique/provenance has been lost before rendering.
